display_name: Shadowgate 64: Trials of the Four Towers
subtitle: BizHawk
_subtitle_source: the world's own setup guide: "As we are using BizHawk, this guide is only applicable to Windows and Linux systems."
_platform_source: N64 title. The setup guide asks for "A Shadowgate 64 ROM (English)" and opens it in BizHawk.
_ap_world_name_source: the world's own shadowgate64/__init__.py: `game = "Shadowgate 64"`, read out of shadowgate64.apworld from release V0.1.
description: The four towers of Castle Shadowgate as a multiworld. Keys, tools and the spells that open each tower are shuffled across the session.
_description_source: written by us from the world's own structure - no text copied from the game.
_checks_verified_note: FALSE. Nobody has played this. The checks travel through the WORLD'S own client, not a RAM map of ours, so the unproven part is the whole chain: apworld installs, the player patches their ROM, BizHawk runs it and a check comes back.
_requires_source: N64 title - the player supplies their own dump, which the world then patches.

rom.description: Your own Shadowgate 64: Trials of the Four Towers (English) ROM
rom._md5_source: read from the world's own shadowgate64/Sg64Client.py, 26 Aug 2026 - the three dumps it accepts.
rom._patched_note: The world patches the ROM itself: "The patched rom is located in your Archipelago root folder". London neither builds nor applies that patch.

emulator.name: BizHawk
emulator._source: the world's setup guide: "Open Bizhawk (2.9.1+) and open your patched Shadowgate 64 game".
emulator._settings_note: ⚠ The setup guide requires one BizHawk setting the player must set themselves: under the N64 menu, enable "Use Expansion Slot". That menu only appears after a ROM is loaded. London does not set it.

client.name: Shadowgate 64 Client
client._name_source: the world registers it itself: shadowgate64/__init__.py does Component("Shadowgate 64 Client", func=run_client, component_type=Type.CLIENT) and launches it with launch_subprocess(main).
client._kind_source: the world ships its own client (shadowgate64/Sg64Client.py, which subclasses CommonContext rather than BizHawkClient) and drives the emulator itself. London installs the apworld and starts BizHawk; it must NOT read memory for this game.
client._protocol_source: the world's setup guide runs the game in BizHawk, which is the backend our bizhawk extension starts for N64.

apworld._source: the author's own releases page, read 26 Aug 2026 (tag V0.1, carrying shadowgate64.apworld and shadowgate64_connector.lua).

_patch_extension_source: read from the world's own source, 26 Aug 2026: no APPatchExtension appears in the package.

world_by.name: jjjj12212

credits._note: The game is the property of its publisher and is never distributed here; the player supplies their own copy. The Archipelago world is its author's work. Only the plugin itself is by solida1987.
